t: What Continuous Active Learning Systems Is
title: What Continuous Active Learning Systems Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Continuous active learning systems are AI that never stops learning: they monitor their own uncertainty, ask humans for labels on the most informative examples, and update themselves in production — getting smarter every day instead of decaying. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Continuous Active Learning Systems: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Continuous Active Learning Systems in one line: Continuous active learning systems are AI that never stops learning: they monitor their own uncertainty, ask humans for labels on the most informative examples, and update themselves in production — getting smarter every day instead of decaying.
Why it matters: Deployed AI rots as the world changes; continuous active learning keeps it fresh automatically..
Where it is used: fraud detection, content moderation, medical imaging, industrial inspection, personalization..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Continuous Active Learning Systems
title: Current Research State of Continuous Active Learning Systems
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Active learning (uncertainty/diversity sampling) matured; continual-learning methods (replay, EWC) reduced forgetting; human-in-the-loop platforms deployed at scale. Research focuses on safe online updates, label efficiency, and detecting distribution shift. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Continuous Active Learning Systems currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
